description: Close all tabs opened by cdpilot, and gracefully quit the browser only if no user-opened tabs remain. Set force=true to quit even if user tabs remain; set keep_browser=true to close cdpilot tabs and keep browser running.

force.description: Close the browser application even if user-opened tabs remain.

keep_browser.description: Only close cdpilot's own tabs; never quit the browser.

name: browser_close
